title: Get Help
meta_description: Official Dish TV portal: offerings, plans, customer care, and products.
cleaned_body:
QUICK HELP
24X7 Customer Care Toll-Free No.
For any queries or issues, please feel free to call us on +91-95017-95017 / 1800-120-3474
$name
Do it Yourself
Login for quick troubleshooting steps or raise a service request
PROCEED
My Account
To update your account, Give us missed call on - 1800 274 4744
To know your account information, Give us missed call on - 1800 274 9000.
Activate a Channel
Give a missed call on 1800-568-XXXX Replace XXXX with channel number for 3 digits channels, prefix "0" before channel number.
Allow 15 minutes for activation
Get 3 days credit
Give a missed call on 1800-274-9050 and Enjoy 3 extra days of TV viewing. Charges for 3 days and a service charge of ₹10 will be adjusted in your next recharge.
Great Offers
Give a missed call on 87506-87506 and Get information about customized offers exclusively available for your account, via SMS. Enjoy great value for money on your regular recharges.
101/102 Error on TV
Services didn’t resume after recharge or not able to watch subscribed channels? Give a missed call on 1800-270-2102 and leave your box on for 15 minutes.
Contact Us
+9198797868687
+919879878987
Email Us
solution@biztechnosys.com
support@biztechnosys.com
PRODUCTS
